functional.title: Job contracts and identity
functional.definition: Persist tenants, operator/client roles, immutable quote revisions, currency and minimum gross margin. Bind the customer to a specific job and version.

functional.title: Cost attribution
functional.definition: Implement append-only direct labor, infra and provider expense entries and shared allocation. Surface the unallocated residual and evidence for adjustments.

functional.title: Reservation and concurrency
functional.definition: Build atomic job-budget reservation and denial reason codes. Validate quote revision, expiry and idempotency payload digest.

functional.title: Paid call dispatch
functional.definition: Bind the winning reservation to the payment-session cap, provider and rail. Persist a dispatch outbox before invoking the provider and save opaque provider references.

functional.title: Receipt and credit reconciliation
functional.definition: Ingest a provider statement, verify merchant and amount, replace the held estimate with the actual cost, and permit evidence-linked corrections.

functional.title: Delivery and close
functional.definition: Capture artifact digest, customer acceptance, realized revenue, expense completeness and immutable close versions. Permit post-close corrections via a new version.

functional.title: Operator console and exports
functional.definition: Expose denial shortfall, reservation owners, unallocated costs, acceptance and adjustment lineage. Generate per-job CSV and a reconciliation view.

functional.title: Restart and pilot proof
functional.definition: Implement recovery harness for two simultaneous workers, an ambiguous dispatch and a late receipt. Replay a consented pilot record through the normal HTTP and UI paths.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Job contracts and identity
invariants.definition: One active quote version per job; its monetary unit never changes.

invariants.title: Cost attribution
invariants.definition: Allocated amounts plus unallocated balance equal each source statement in minor units.

invariants.title: Reservation and concurrency
invariants.definition: Sum of approved holds never exceeds routed headroom at approval time.

invariants.title: Paid call dispatch
invariants.definition: Ambiguous provider outcomes cannot release spend capacity or trigger a new charge.

invariants.title: Receipt and credit reconciliation
invariants.definition: A settled receipt changes net cost once across worker and webhook paths.

invariants.title: Delivery and close
invariants.definition: Actual profit requires accepted revenue; an outstanding uncertain payment prevents a final reconciled close.

invariants.title: Operator console and exports
invariants.definition: Report values agree with the same journal cursor used to produce the close.

invariants.title: Restart and pilot proof
invariants.definition: A process restart preserves budget decisions, acceptance identity and journal totals.
